title: プログラミングⅡ
subtitle: Programming II
educationalGoal: Subsequent to the precedent course, i.e., Programming I, students learn basic Python programming to acquire writing various programs. Specifically, students learn the following: using objects, iterators, and file operations.
advice: In this class, students learn basic Python programming subsequent to the precedent class, i.e., Programming I. Contents of Python: (1) Data containers such as dictionary and set (2) Concept of object, and class (3) Programming with iterators that is the mechanism of accessing stored data (4) Writing complicated programs using file I/O or exceptions
requiredKnowledge: The precedent course: Programming I - Students have to bring own laptop computer, AC adopter, and network cable for software installation, download of course materials, and upload of answer of quizzes - PC operation skills (such as touch typing, file operation, etc.) are necessary to write program smoothly

activityGoals.body: Be able to write Python programs using dictionary, and/or set
Be able to write Python programs using objects
Be able to write Python programs operating data in data structure using iterator appropriately
Be able to write Python programs operating file I/O
